A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–G are readable and support comparison; the different pagination reflects reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original representation and intervention experiments using Gemma-2B and LLaMA-3-8B, including WordNet evaluations in Section 5 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including measured projection distributions, hierarchical similarities, and intervention results.

M1.justification: The representation framework and empirical estimation procedure are unchanged, including whitening and centering in Equation 5.1 and the LDA estimator in Equation 5.2. The revised theoretical origin condition does not change the implemented procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same WordNet noun and verb coverage, including 593 noun and 364 verb synsets for Gemma, and the same animal/plant visualization examples. Appendix F retains the LLaMA-3 noun evaluations.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same shuffled-unembedding and random-parent controls, mean-vector estimator, and Euclidean-inner-product alternative. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Both retain the 70/30 token split, independently sampled 70% subsets for testing set-inclusion effects, minimum 50-word synset filter, model configurations, and evaluation quantities. Appendix E identifies the same experiments using unsplit token collections.

E4.justification: The intervention checks, set-inclusion controls, parent-grandparent orthogonality analysis, mean-estimator comparison, no-whitening comparison, and animal-subtree analysis are all retained in Section 5 and Appendix F.

E5.justification: Both report the same means and standard deviations across words or token pairs, including Figure 3 and Table 1. There is no change to error-bar practices, run-count disclosures, or statistical testing.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains all six numerical entries, including 5.1265 ± 1.1731 for plant-to-animal and -0.0600 ± 1.2190 for mammal-to-reptile logit changes. The empirical figure images and their reported findings also match across versions.

T1.justification: Theorem 4 generalizes its canonical-origin condition from d causally separable attributes to d linearly independent feature representations. Appendix B.1 replaces the sum-of-origins construction with a linear system and a unique-solution argument. This is a localized generalization; the magnitude result and remaining theoretical results are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same central contributions: vector representations of binary features, polytope representations of categorical concepts, hierarchical orthogonality, and empirical validation on Gemma and LLaMA-3.

C2.justification: The interpretations of semantic structure versus set-inclusion artifacts remain unchanged. Both retain the qualifications about imperfect representations, implications for sparse autoencoders, and the limitation of the whitening approach to final-layer representations.

D1.justification: The same code access information, model dimensions, token filtering, synset processing, and manually inspected ChatGPT-generated visualization sets remain documented. Moving the abstract's code disclosure into a footnote does not change access.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to linear representations, hyperbolic geometry, partial orthogonality, and sparse autoencoders are unchanged. Bibliographic expansion and author-year citation formatting do not introduce new related work.

P1.justification: v3 adds funding acknowledgments, simplifies the affiliation text, adopts author-year citations, and moves the abstract's code disclosure to a footnote. Section and appendix order and nearly all explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The document is comprehensively reformatted into the ICLR template, changing typography, heading and caption styling, running headers, spacing, and figure placement throughout. Figures 4 and 5 now share a page, and appendix figures are regrouped. All 20 figures and Table 1 remain.

improvement.justification: Theorem 4 and Appendix B.1 provide a more general canonical-origin construction, replacing causal separability with linear independence and explicitly establishing a unique solution. This improves one theoretical step's applicability and justification. The main conclusions and empirical support remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
